settings.title: We set it up before it ships
settings.text: Send your Google Maps link and we find your review link, program every stand and type up your menu. It works the day it arrives.

settings.title: No app for your guests
settings.text: A tap opens your Google review page. A scan opens your live menu. Guests don't download or sign up for anything.

settings.title: Change anything, anytime
settings.text: With the tapfour app you edit links and menu prices once and every stand follows. Nothing to reprint.

settings.title: Honest by design
settings.text: Every guest can review you, not just the happy ones, the way Google wants it. Cancel the app anytime and your stand keeps working.

settings.title: One tap between a happy guest and your next review.
settings.intro:
tapfour makes NFC Google review stands, live QR menus and a simple owner app for cafés, restaurants and shops across the Philippines.

Most happy guests would leave a review. They just never get around to searching for your shop. Our glossy Tapfour Connect stand sits on the table or counter: one tap opens your Google review page, one scan opens your menu, and the tapfour app shows you every tap, your busiest hours and what guests open.

We ship nationwide, from Luzon to Visayas to Mindanao, and we set everything up before it leaves us.
